name: readline line events
source: import { createInterface } from 'node:readline'; import { Readable } from 'node:stream'; function main(): void { const lines: string[] = []; const input = Readable.from(['one\n', 'two\n']); const reader = createInterface({ input, terminal: false }); reader.on('line', (line: string): void => { lines.push(line); }); reader.on('close', (): void => console.log(lines.join(','))); input.resume(); }
